status.note: All {PARAM}/null arm sizes are resolved exactly once from the measured resident-cost curve before freeze; post-freeze mutation invalidates the pinned hash and refuses execution.

list_add.even: Add {k} to each integer in the list.
list_add.odd: Increase every integer in the list by {k}.

identity_prompts.train_list: Pass through the supplied integer list unchanged.
identity_prompts.calibration_scalar: Keep the given integer exactly as it is.
identity_prompts.calibration_list: Keep every integer in the given list as it is.

cohort_disjointness.requirement: regenerate all tasks under the a013 domains; no a013 task prompt+signature byte pair may equal any a012 task byte pair; identifier sets must be disjoint

readout.resident_bytes_formula: 64*V*K + V*C + small per-output terms; independent of N

lanes.note: not rerun anywhere in this ladder; framing axis is carried by A1@L6 vs A2@L3

arms.purpose: re-measure the sealed a012 operating point under the local sparse three-factor readout; isolates the readout-rule change at known scale
maximum feasible dose; shortfall vs target recorded at freeze if measurements require it
keeps the framing/supervision axis at matched scale versus L3

expected_accounting_token_level.invariance: identical for every arm; N changes reservoir size only, never token counts
expected_accounting_token_level.framing_decomposition: 7156 canonical signature bytes + 1244 UTF-8 prompt bytes + 84 delimiter tokens

per_arm_expected_accounting.definition: each arm carries this block with scale fields evaluated at its frozen N; loader requires exact equality per arm

scale_fields.formula: 181*N (measured B/cell incl. sparse readout; estimate, never a gate)
evaluated at finalization from measured tok/s(N, activity density); estimate, never a gate

cost_model_anchors.residency_statement: 60 B/cell floor implies >= 6 TB live state at 100B configured and ~10 TB at 170B: full-touch simulation is out of reach on one workstation; sparse event-driven residency where token cost tracks resident cells is the only path.
cost_model_anchors.activity_density_policy: every arm declares an assumed activity density used only for planning estimates and telemetry; it never enters any eligibility gate

diagnostics.state_sample: the exact N-float64 eligibility vector immediately before each emitted-token race
diagnostics.state_bytes: little-endian IEEE-754 float64 C-order bytes; exactly 8*N bytes per sample
diagnostics.collision_key: SHA-256 over the complete eligibility byte vector, grouped with allowed_cell_ids; O(1) stored per decision plus first/last 1024-byte sealed excerpts
diagnostics.decision_collision: reject if exact full-vector digest repeats for the same allowed-cell set at decisions with different expected targets
diagnostics.state_separation_formula: 1-cosine(e_i,e_j); both-zero=0 and exactly-one-zero=1; streaming accumulation over full vectors
diagnostics.state_separation_aggregation: report count, minimum, p10, median, and mean separately for Int and List[Int] pairs; persisted summaries only
diagnostics.state_separation_question: exploratory, non-veto: does separation improve with N?
diagnostics.fading_formula: direct eligibility retention exp(-(token_distance*5ms)/80ms); A1/A2 distance 1 token = 5 ms; non-veto regression monitor for the a012-confirmed framing fix (0.9394)
diagnostics.target_margin_pair_set: every competitive TRAIN teacher position in a sealed A2 exact-replay completion
diagnostics.target_margin_formula: current(expected target)-max current(other allowed target), in pA
diagnostics.target_margin_aggregation: report count, minimum, p10, median, and mean; minimum must be finite and strictly positive

eligibility_gates.completion_phase: seal all of an arm's completions before any label, case, family, or template scoring

capacity_family.meaning: fits the curriculum at this N

generalization_family.meaning: transfers to opposite-template/literal calibration at this N

eligibility_gates.all_or_nothing: an arm is eligible only if BOTH families pass together with every mandatory common gate; partial passes never count

readout_capacity_family.fan_in_budget: at most 64 learned synapses per output cell at every sealed decision
readout_capacity_family.weight_magnitude_bound: all weights finite and within the frozen bound {PARAM: w_bound}
readout_capacity_family.resident_byte_accounting: persisted readout bytes match 64*V*K + V*C + small per-output terms within tolerance
readout_capacity_family.dense_layout_refusal: no (N,N) or (V,N) float allocation permitted in the ladder path

eligibility_gates.feasibility_precheck: before creating an arm claim marker, projected resident bytes and wall time from the measured curve at the declared activity density must fit the frozen envelope; refusal records cause and removes the arm without execution

preregistered_reading: capacity fails below some N and passes above, generalization passes above: pure capacity defect resolving with scale; continue per ladder, no architecture change
capacity passes but generalization fails at every N including L5: fits-but-does-not-generalize; stop scaling, new hypothesis and fresh cohort
neither family passes anywhere with healthy margins: learner/state defect; inspect readout dynamics and state separation; do not resize again
integrity or accounting failure: implementation defect; new protocol version; affected cohorts spent
ladder_interpretation.rollup_authority: the ladder roll-up record lists per-arm eligibility and is the sole ladder-level eligibility statement

execution.arm_claims: one exclusive spent marker set per arm: artifacts/.typed_composition_a013_ladder_v1_<arm>.claimed (+ .claiming staging, .invalid poison, .complete authority; POSIX fsync / Windows MoveFileExW WRITE_THROUGH no-replace semantics as a012)
execution.failure_isolation: an arm failing any gate is terminal for that arm only; remaining arms still run; no retry, resume, resize, or reorder exists for a claimed arm
execution.cross_arm_immutability: no arm outcome may alter any later arm's parameters; mid-ladder protocol byte change aborts the current arm with .invalid
execution.runtime_backend: native CPU sparse/event-driven path for all arms; HUMANBRAIN_DEVICE=cuda is rejected for ladder execution
execution.production_checkout: derive the repository root from every imported local runtime module and require this exact checkout/protocol before evidence, model construction, or native execution

source_bundle_paths.freeze_rule: the plan must mechanically require every imported local runtime module plus native build closure in the bundle before --execute is accepted

execution.checkpoint_schema: v5 with explicit cell_count and sparse readout state; v4 and v3 unsupported, no compatibility loader
execution.resume_policy: no resume and no second attempt of any claimed protocol/arm/cohort under any run identifier after success or failure
execution.development_policy: DEV-v1 remains retired; a012 artifacts remain sealed spent evidence and are never rerun or used for tuning
execution.selection_policy: A1 (and the retired A0) are diagnostic only; every A2 arm is a capability candidate on its own cohort; no winner selection across arms; public sealing/scoring returns diagnostics only; verified per-arm 999-terminal-summary envelopes are the sole per-arm authorities
execution.run_hold: No material TRAIN, calibration, or future-cohort execution is authorized by this draft or its freeze; separate authorization naming the exact frozen protocol and source-bundle hashes is required.

future_regioned_variant.sketch: separate encoder-region (prompt/signature ingestion) + processor-region (program-token competition and readout) circuit with region-local state, explicit inter-region projection budgets, and its own preregistered accounting
